mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS resource_id, r.kind, v.id AS version_id, v.version_no, v.name, v.description, v.published_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.icon')) AS icon, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.color')) AS color FROM resource_version v JOIN resource r ON r.enterprise_id = v.enterprise_id AND r.id = v.resource_id
